name: CASBOT W1
summary: A 260 kg wheeled humanoid with two 7-axis arms (5 kg each) on a lifting column that reaches 0 to 2.1 m, for shelf picking, machine loading and inspection rounds.

germany.statusNote: No shop price: Roboter Deutschland (US-run web shop) lists W1 for quotation only; CASBOT sells its 02 humanoid in Germany through RBTX, so a request to CASBOT or the reseller is the route.

sellers.name: CASBOT (Beijing Zhongke Huiling Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
sellers.note: Maker contact; no buy link for W1 on the maker site.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: 7 per arm, 2 neck, 1 waist, 1 lift, 2 chassis; grippers extra

specs.label: Working height
specs.conditions: arm span 2.04 m with grippers; arm working radius 0.61 m

specs.label: Protection rating
specs.conditions: as printed in the maker table, next to local air cooling

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Industrial PC (Intel i9 + RTX 4060) plus RK3588

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Head stereo and RGB-D cameras, RGB-D on each wrist and chest, LiDAR navigation, 2-mic array

notes: Ships with 2-finger grippers; dexterous hands or suction cups can be fitted.
Differential-drive wheeled base with LiDAR navigation (±10 mm), autonomous charging; wheeled, so no stairs.
Maker table prints IP68 next to local air cooling; treated as unconfirmed, so no IP rating is given here.
